facts.fact: Law no. 2016-007 on cybercrime was adopted by the National Assembly and the Senate and promulgated by the President of the Republic, with 52 articles covering offences, search and interception powers, and international cooperation; the document carries no usable day, so the year is taken from the law number and its published date.
facts.system: Loi n° 2016-007 relative à la cybercriminalité
